reason: It sounds nice and the price is fair with the host and cleanup included, but it's not open until next year and my party is in the next few months. I'm not putting a deposit on a place that doesn't exist yet, so I'd go with CoCo's or the trampoline park.
objection: It isn't open yet and has no track record. I can't book a date I'd need in a few months at a place I've never seen, with no reviews and no idea how the kids will actually behave in a quiet Montessori space.
would_change_my_mind: It being open before my date, with a few reviews or a chance to visit, and a refundable deposit.
